end.en: Verify activeUse and actual available materials; inspect the original request if rejected or inactive

prerequisites.en: Check existing use rights and request status; wait while pending. Private licensed materials use owner entitlement; other assets use the existing access request.

prerequisites.zh: 提供方只在获准范围内批准或拒绝。目录可见、申请获批与 activeUse 不等价；未生效时仍不可视作可用材料。
prerequisites.en: Providers approve or reject within scope. Catalog visibility, approval and activeUse are distinct; inactive access is not usable material.

prerequisites.zh: 版本已获准取用并实际准备；私有自有非许可材料不需要额外申请。本图不会自动复制文件。
prerequisites.en: The version is authorized and actually prepared. Private owner-held non-licensed material requires no extra request. This map does not copy files.

label.zh: 已具有效使用权／自有非许可材料
拒绝或授权未生效：核查原申请

end.en: Verify availability from actual install records; retain waiting or failure handling when unfinished

caution.en: Use the existing form and server checks. Execution, delivery, accounting and evidence are independent.

prerequisites.zh: 需要当前主体具备对应入口权限；具体校验以现有表单为准
prerequisites.en: Requires access to the existing entrance; its form enforces the actual checks

input.zh: 业务目标与已准备材料

prerequisites.zh: 先核查目标提供方、集群与 Agent 的有效策略；preinstalled-only、受信自动安装、显式安装授权的条件不同。
prerequisites.en: Inspect effective provider, cluster and Agent policy. Preinstalled-only, trusted automatic installation and explicit grants have different conditions.

prerequisites.zh: 材料修订、源码或构建缓存、环境及 runtime 绑定有效；预装映射需核实实际安装，导入锁文件不算安装。
prerequisites.en: Material revision, source or build cache, environment and runtime bindings must be valid; verify actual preinstalled software. Importing a lock is not installation.

prerequisites.zh: 实际操作可能排队、运行、失败或完成；只在已有软件记录内核查，失败按原操作与策略处理，图示不触发安装。
prerequisites.en: Actual operations may be queued, running, failed or completed. Inspect the existing record and handle failures under its policy; the diagram never installs software.

label.zh: 仅预装：核查已安装映射

prerequisites.zh: 发布范围与访问批准独立；撤回可见性不等于删除已分发副本。
prerequisites.en: Publication scope and access approval are separate. Revoking visibility is not deletion of distributed copies.
